title: An active standard Net term can be made default, moved or deactivated
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Net 45 is active and held by at least one customer.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  2. Hover "Deactivate".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Make Default for New Customers" (circle check), "Move Customers" (person), "Deactivate" (archive). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "Hide from customer and vendor pickers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R1 table, Deactivate row: “"Deactivate" (archive) | Active terms except COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold | The term is the default: "This is your default for new customers" with "Pick another default first." below”
  • S2-R3: “Hovering "Deactivate" (when not blocked) shows "Hide from customer and vendor pickers". Hovering "Reactivate" shows "Show in pickers again".”
  • S2-N1: “Standard terms never show "Edit" or "Delete Credit Term".”
  • Key Decisions: “Any other standard term (Net 7 to Net 120) can be deactivated to shorten the pickers.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover Deactivate / Reactivate | "Hide from customer and vendor pickers" / "Show in pickers again" | Tooltip on hover”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
